_comentario: Items appearing in events, shop and combat rewards. 'equipable' is assigned to a specific character (one slot per character) and only benefits whoever carries it — if you unequip it or replace that character, the item returns to inventory (revivirUnaVez is the exception: consumed on activation, doesn't return). 'consumible' is spent once used on a character.

objetos.descripcion: Instantly restores HP to a character, at the cost of future fatigue.
If the equipped carrier falls in battle, they revive with 1 HP. Consumed on activation (does not return to inventory).
